import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a violin plot for quality of sleep vs age group
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Quality of Sleep', data=data, inner=None)
ax.set_title('Quality of Sleep by Age Group')
ax.set_xlabel('Age')
ax.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.tight_layout()

# Create a scatter plot for daily steps vs heart rate
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Daily Steps', y='Heart Rate', hue='Gender', data=data)
ax = plt.gca()
ax.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Gender')
ax.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax.set_ylabel('Heart Rate')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.tight_layout()

# Create a bar chart for sleep duration by occupation
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', data=data)
ax = plt.gca()
ax.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figures
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.pairplot(data, vars=['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level'],
             plot_kws={'alpha': 0.5})
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Metrics')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a violin plot for quality of sleep vs age group
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Quality of Sleep', data=data, inner=None)
ax.set_title('Quality of Sleep by Age Group')
ax.set_xlabel('Age')
ax.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.tight_layout()

# Create a scatter plot for daily steps vs heart rate
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Daily Steps', y='Heart Rate', hue='Gender', data=data)
ax = plt.gca()
ax.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Gender')
ax.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax.set_ylabel('Heart Rate')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.tight_layout()

# Create a bar chart for sleep duration by occupation
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', data=data)
ax = plt.gca()
ax.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figures
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.pairplot(data, vars=['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level'],
             plot_kws={'alpha': 0.5})
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Metrics')
plt.tight_layout()
